{{Quote|When she talked about the past it seemed real, you know? The suffering before the Great Time of Peace wasn't ancient history, but just ''yesterday'', and the people who lived through it mattered.|Ian Lago, speaking of Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Dream">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>}}
The '''Time of Suffering''' was a period of war between the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[City/Legends|city-states]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], lasting from approximately [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] to [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] ended the conflict by uniting the city-states, after which he became [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king]] of Naboo and the city [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] became the new planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

==The conflict==
The Time of Suffering was a series of brutal wars between the [[City/Legends|city-states]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Nexus" /> It began around [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]<ref name="Begindate" /> and lasted around 200 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until a [[General/Legends|general]] named [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] united the city-states through his will and military might, ending the conflict in [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]].<ref name="Nexus" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I paint my lips red and add the red scar of remembrance that splits my lip. It is a Naboo ruling tradition, older than memory, that marks a time of suffering for Naboo, before the Great Time of Peace.|Queen Padmé Amidala, in her journal|<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Theed.png|thumb|right|300px|Theed (pictured) became the capital of Naboo in the aftermath of the Time of Suffering.]]
Shortly after the end of the Time of Suffering, the small city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] rapidly expanded due to an influx of artisans, [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], and [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]<ref name="Starship">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|36|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> and was inaugurated as Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jafan became [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]], ushering in the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]] for Naboo.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> Later [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]] would traditionally wear the [[Scar of remembrance/Legends|scar of remembrance]], a [[Color/Legends|red]] painted line on their [[Mouth/Legends|lips]],<ref name="Journal" /> and the name of the Time of Suffering was used in Naboo history [[Book/Legends|books]].<ref name="Nexus" />

During her [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Princess of Theed]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] gave speeches that, according to her admirer [[Ian Lago]], made the individuals who had experienced the Time of Suffering seem contemporary and significant.<ref name="Dream" /> When Amidala became [[Gender/Legends|queen]] of Naboo<ref name="Journal" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="New Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the beginning of {{Film|I}}, and therefore the beginning of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], on the date 3:4:14 in the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] became [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the invasion. Therefore, Amidala's coronation must have taken place around 2:10 in the Great ReSynchronization dating system, which corresponds to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> she wrote about the significance of the scar of remembrance in her [[Padmé Amidala's journal|journal]].<ref name="Journal" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Deftoi]] of [[Muntro VI]], a world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], staged an edition of their decennial [[Otherworld Arts Festival]]. The festival included a quasi-operatic performance depicting the events of the Time of Suffering. For this purpose, the Deftoi requested the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of Naboo to provide carcasses of Naboo animals for the show.<ref name="SWG:AFRNA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Arts Festival Requires Naboo Animals}} on Naboo</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The event that would eventually be named the Time of Suffering was first mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] by [[David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Its proper name was subsequently given in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The Time of Suffering was indirectly mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AFRNA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In a cut quest, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] of Naboo lost the ceremonial makeup used for creating the scar of remembrance and compared that suffering to the experiences of the Naboo during the Time of Suffering. The player would have been requested to retrieve the makeup.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>
